method: Exact clipping of original painted inner-disc surfaces and hub, retaining the largest area connected source component. Disconnected original case/support fragments return to the static body. Measured existing rim boundary receives only an inset internal back and side closure; the new internal back ring alone uses boundary-arclength parameterization to avoid tiny projected rim foldbacks, and original ring vertices remain unchanged; small cut boundaries interpolate UV from original nearby painted/bronze source faces. This is original neural front geometry with local mechanical cut repairs, not a replacement disc or image repaint.
limitations: Original outer bronze rim and rear case stay fixed while the painted inner face and original hub rotate.
New internal closure is a documented mechanical repair, not unseen native-generated rear geometry.
Requires actual asymmetric pose review before approval.
